name: Sea campion
note: Sea campion, Silene uniflora (docs/future/10). Drawn with the thrift shader (draw: thrift; flora-thrift.wgsl), so its keys are the thrift's: a low, loose mat of broader grey-green leaves with white flowers on short stalks, each bulging where its papery calyx swells. habitat works as in reeds.json, with the ground axes (docs/future/10): campion wants bare rock near the sea, any slope, salty and well drained, never standing water, and higher on the shore than sea thrift (shoreM: height above mean sea level, m; thrift starts at 0.3 m), so the two keep apart. It is not a starter (recipes/world/growth.json starters): it arrives by itself, last of the volunteers, once you have set rock by the sea. It flowers through summer and stays green, low, over winter. spread kind seed.

phenology.note: each plant keeps its own calendar, offset from the species by up to jitterDays game days either way (hash of the plant id; src/world/growth/phenology.js), so its flowering, seeding and dormant windows (and the willow's leaf-out and leaf fall) do not all turn on the same hour
